verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an MSI package, MDM deployment, or a documented silent or unattended install. The custom-branded client generator, the 90+ configurable options, centralized settings, and pointing the client at a server via the .exe filename all relate to preset configuration. None of them is a documented mass-deployment mechanism, so they count only as adjacent features. Mass deployment is a fair axis for a remote-desktop client, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
